School Khan Younis Operational Struck Jul 9, 2024; GBU-39 bomb hit the gate. 31+ killed (mostly women and children), 53+ injured. Fourth school attack in four days.

Airstrike

📍 Al-Awda School — Abasan al-Kabira, Khan Younis

Full description

An Israeli air attack on a school housing displaced Palestinians in southern Gaza has killed at least 30 people in the fourth such attack in as many days. The attack in the town of Abbasan, east of Khan Younis, hit the entrance of al-Awdah school, wounding at least 53 people.
